title: Debug: Broken Names
prompt: This checkout page's names are quietly broken: the cards image has empty alt, the email label never associates with its field, the promo label's for= points at the wrong id, 'Pay now' is a div role="button", and 'Buy now' hides its visible text behind a conflicting aria-label. Fix every name the right way: real alt text, for/id association, a real <button>, and visible text as the source of truth.
boilerplate:
Checkout

Pay now

tests.name: image gets a real name
tests.hint: alt="" means decorative — accepted payment logos are content. Describe them.

tests.name: every label is associated
tests.hint: Two association paths: <label for> matching the input's id, or wrapping the input. The email label uses neither.

tests.name: no fake buttons
tests.hint: role="button" adds the role but not the behavior — focus, Enter/Space, disabled all come free with <button>.

tests.name: visible text wins on Buy now
tests.hint: Speech users say what they see. When aria-label disagrees with visible text, the name is wrong — delete the aria-label.
